verdicts.reason: A breaks the design apart. 'DDG STUDIO PRESENTS' and 'THE MINIMALIST' are pulled to the far left, away from the headline. 'DEAN COOPER' runs over the cut-off pattern strip and its white card edge. The frame and the two pink dots end up in an empty box on the right, so most of the banner is dead white space. B keeps the text block together and in the right order, but the pattern is cut down to thin slivers at the top and bottom of a narrow centre column. The empty frame with its dots sits alone on the left, the right third is blank, and the layout is a shrunken square in a banner instead of being rearranged to read left to right.
